'''Shah'adrom'illithyr''', known as '''Hadro''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he posted a [[Blacklist]] [[Bounty/Legends|Bounty]] on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Reneget Vause]], who had been wreaking havoc on the Chiss-occupied territory on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] took on the contract and received directions from Shah'adrom'illithyr to a [[White Maw]] prisoner held captive in [[Dorn Base]]. After the hunter showed proof of Vause's death, Shah'adrom'illithyr was persuaded into letting the prisoner, [[Blizz]], go free and join the hunter's crew.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aristocra Shah'adrom'illithyr appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Cool Reception" on Hoth and is voice acted by [[Christopher Neame]].
